title: Fix the Assign action business-logic function in Manage Ticket Queue so it updat
description:
Fix the Assign action in Manage Ticket Queue. The current runtime error is: UndefinedTable: relation "twasta.SUPPORT360_TICKET" does not exist. The Assign action is generating a raw SQL UPDATE against twasta.SUPPORT360_TICKET, which is incorrect for this application's runtime data model. Do not create another raw SQL reference to this table. Use the same working dict-based database/model access pattern already used elsewhere in Support360.

When Assign is clicked, it must:

Identify the selected Ticket No.
Identify the selected Agent.
Update the ticket's STATUS to Assigned.
Update ASSIGNED_AGENT with the selected agent.
Create an Activity Log entry for the assignment.
Show a success message instead of an error.

First inspect the existing working ticket data/model bindings and reuse the correct table/model reference. Do not guess the table name and do not use db.t("SUPPORT360_TICKET") or raw SQL against twasta.SUPPORT360_TICKET. Deploy the fix and perform a runtime test by assigning an existing ticket to an agent. If the fix cannot be applied automatically, tell me exactly which object/action must be edited rather than marking the task complete.
